title: Motorcycles & Powersports Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride) OR (index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="rever:ride","primary",sourcetype="garmin:zumo","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from rever:ride and garmin:zumo to see whether two motorcycles feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `rever:ride` and `garmin:zumo` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main motorcycles data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
